description_en: Collects a single public web page into the enterprise knowledge base of the current user
description_zh: 采集单个公开网页到当前用户的企业知识库
name: CreateKnowledgeBasePublicUrl

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the public HTTP/HTTPS web page
parameters.help_zh: 公开 HTTP/HTTPS 网页 URL
parameters.name: original_url

parameters.help_en: The resource name. If not specified, the URL is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称；省略时使用 URL
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination folder in the enterprise knowledge base. This parameter is required. You must have knowledge base management permissions on the knowledge base
parameters.help_zh: 目标企业知识库目录 ID；必填，必须具备该知识库管理权限
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the operating object
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The list of resource tags as JSON strings
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签 JSON 字符串列表
parameters.name: source_tags

200.description_en: 采集公开网页到企业知识库
200.description_zh: 采集公开网页到企业知识库

schema.description_en: The response for collecting a public web page into the enterprise knowledge base
schema.description_zh: 采集公开网页到企业知识库

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

directoryId.description_en: The ID of the destination folder in the enterprise knowledge base that was specified in the request
directoryId.description_zh: 实际请求的企业知识库目标目录 ID

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

message.description_en: The error description. This value is empty if the request is successful

originalUrl.description_en: The submitted public web page URL
originalUrl.description_zh: 已提交的公开网页 URL

scope.description_en: The resource scope. The value is fixed to TENANT

sourceId.description_en: The ID of the newly created source

status.description_en: The resource status. A value of RUNNING indicates that the request has been accepted but the crawling and parsing are not yet complete
status.description_zh: 资源状态；RUNNING 表示已受理，尚未完成抓取和解析
